caption: The drawing features two main objects on a light, beige background. On the left, there is a detailed illustration of a metallic object shaped like the letter "B," rendered in shades of brown, gold, and bronze, with realistic shading to indicate a three-dimensional form; the object has a bar extending horizontally from the midpoint, ending in a small loop. To the right of this metallic object is a simple, flat, light brown or reddish drawing of the uppercase letter "B," rendered in a sketchy, outline style, with no additional details or shading. The composition is minimal, with both objects placed near the center of the image, and the artist's name, "Elizabeth Johnson," is written in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Branding Iron
